name: v0.3.14 horizon handoff nested boundary
one_shot_semantics: After this protocol commit and the later candidate-freeze commit, run the 10 preregistered candidate cells once. Rerun only an exact cell that fails for infrastructure reasons. Do not change the commitment boundary, witness rule, unwind rule, budgets, or targets after the first target evaluation.
research_question: Can nested branches remain ordinary continuation while the current sequence still has more than one commitment slot, but become a real child sequence only when the branch would consume the final commitment slot?
success_means: Protocol integrity and reproducible evidence on inspected cases. Not a fresh-generalization claim.

reason_outcome_unchanged: DeepBench lost BUG-D11, BUG-D13, BUG-D14, and BUG-D7

when_all: mode is structural or otherwise sequence-like
selected action is a branch click
do: do not start a child sequence
do not terminate the outer sequence as lost_parent
keep the same sequence instance id and the same outer parent hub
discover the nested branch and record a structural attempt
do not emit branch_start and do not mark the branch started or returned
emit nested_continuation
execute the action as the current sequence action and decrement commitment by one
preserve historical mutation, follow-up, finding, and crash behavior

when_all: selected action is a branch click
do: consume the outer final slot in that frame: branch_actions + 1, _seq_len + 1, stored commitment 0
do not emit an outer sequence_action, mutation, or finding for the same browser action
snapshot a deferred-horizon frame with resume_commitment 0, resume_returning true, deferred_horizon true
do not emit sequence_horizon_reached yet and do not physically restore the outer
start the nested branch as a real historical child with BRANCH_HORIZON, branch_start, and a new sequence instance
the browser action is the child's first sequence action
emit horizon_handoff_started
push a frame only for this final-slot handoff
handoff_condition.dual_lifecycle: The outer frame records a consumed control-flow slot. The child records the actual sequence execution. Global browser actions, mutations, and findings are not double-counted.

deferred_horizon.at_handoff: Do not activate the outer return policy while the browser is inside the child.
after_valid_witness: restore the outer identity, parent, and counters
emit exactly one sequence_horizon_reached with reason horizon_handoff_resolved
do not count the restoration itself as an outer return attempt

witness_definition.not_sufficient: ledger.return_success greater than the value before the call
frame_records: suspended outer sequence instance id, branch, and parent signature/cluster
child sequence instance id and child branch
child parent exact signature and child parent cluster
before_pop_all: the resolution belongs to that frame's child branch and child instance, including when finding or crash already cleared _open_instance
historical return_success increased for this child resolution
new_sig equals the recorded child parent signature or the destination cluster equals the recorded child parent cluster
historical logic cleared the active child return obligation
witness_definition.same_step_finding_or_crash: Valid when identity and the physical parent witness hold. Do not convert that terminal into returned and do not emit a second child terminal.
witness_definition.finding_without_parent: Do not resume. The outer stays suspended until a later physical parent witness or an escape unwind.
witness_definition.wrong_child: An unrelated instance, branch, or global return_success delta does not pop.
witness_definition.wrong_parent: A destination that misses both the recorded exact signature and the recorded cluster does not pop.
witness_definition.cluster_scope: Only the recorded child parent cluster. Not an arbitrary current hub cluster.

unwind_rule.when: The active child emits return_cycle_escape before a parent witness.
do: keep the historical child escape accounting
do not resume the outer
emit an auditable terminal for each open suspended instance
clear the handoff stack
do not mark ancestors returned or completed

reset_rule: reset() clears the handoff stack, child-identity witness state, candidate counters, and return-cycle active-frame history.
stack_rule: Frames are pushed only on final-slot handoff. Continuation never pushes. Recursion is allowed when a child later reaches its own final slot. There is no numeric depth cap. The browser budget is the bound.

safety_tests.H1: nested continuation at commitment 2 keeps the outer id, pushes nothing, and leaves commitment 1
safety_tests.H2: continuation is discovered and structurally attempted without a new sequence instance or child branch_start
safety_tests.H3: final-slot handoff consumes the outer slot, stores commitment 0, and starts a real child
safety_tests.H4: child commitment is a fresh historical window and the stored outer commitment stays 0
safety_tests.H5: exact child-parent witness pops one frame, restores returning with commitment 0, and emits one deferred horizon
safety_tests.H6: cluster-variant destination is a valid cluster witness
safety_tests.H7: same-step finding plus cluster witness resumes without a fake returned terminal
safety_tests.H8: same-step crash plus parent witness resumes without converting crash to returned
safety_tests.H9: finding without a parent witness does not resume
safety_tests.H10: wrong parent does not witness or pop even if return_success changes
safety_tests.H11: wrong child identity does not witness or pop
safety_tests.H12: a global return_success delta alone does not pop
safety_tests.H13: child exact-repeat escape unwinds the stack without returned or completed inflation
safety_tests.H14: recursive handoff restores LIFO, child then outer, each into return phase
safety_tests.H15: resumed outer targets its original parent, not the child parent
safety_tests.H16: a hub chain longer than BRANCH_HORIZON continues while commitment > 1 and hands off only on the final slot
safety_tests.H17: budget end accounts for every open instance once
safety_tests.H18: reset leaves no frame or witness contamination
safety_tests.H19: traces with no nested hub handoff match v0.3.9 guard behavior
safety_tests.H20: every started sequence instance has exactly one legal terminal
safety_tests.model: pure handoff model over C,H,P,V,X,F,E for lengths 1..5, raw traces 19607, invariant failures 0
safety_tests.exhaustive: historical bounded return model, 5800 traces, zero failures

model_invariants: P or V pops at most one matching top frame
E clears the stack without ancestor return-success inflation
a resumed frame enters return phase with commitment 0

comparison_sources.note: Use committed historical evidence as controls. Do not silently substitute newly rerun controls.

mechanism_repair_gate.baseline: committed v0.3.11 guard collapse of 5 states and 5 normalized URLs
all: no commitment-window nested branch causes historical lost_parent preemption
candidate does not show pushes > 0 and resumes/unwinds == 0 and max_depth == pushes and horizon == 0
mechanism_repair_gate.not_required: candidate state count beats v0.3.12 flattening

regression_gates.outcome_A_requires: zero losses against these guard-confirmed sets

outcome_gates.priority: C, then D, then B, else A

C.label: unsafe / protocol-invalid
any: historical safety regression caused by edits

D.label: safe but mechanism not repaired
D.when: Safety passes, and CRM mechanism repair fails or Ops mechanism repair fails.

B.label: mechanism repaired, regression mixed
B.when: Safety passes, CRM repair passes, Ops repair passes, and at least one guard-confirmed bug is lost on BuggyDesk, DeepBench, Wiki, or BuggyShop.
